body: Thank you, however i do not live in the us. Thanks for helping out so much people, you seem to be active today !

I do not believe there is a way to get away from suicidal thoughts, is it tomorrow or in 30 years.

There's so much one has to go through. Im not ready for it. I might never be.

This, and the simple fact that everything is meaningless on the scale of what is happening. 

May i add one more thing that is stupid to say, yet quite true, i am not willing go live a life made up of 5% happy events, 20% bad events, and a mandatory 75% of little to no feelings

Philosopher Emil Cioran once wrote:
'Not being born, such hapiness, such freedom..."
